statement.zh: **标准**：零信任架构（SP 800-207）（Zero Trust Architecture (SP 800-207)）。摘要第一句给术语定位：「Zero trust (ZT) is the term for an evolving set of cybersecurity paradigms that move defenses from static, network-based perimeters to focus on users, assets, and resources.」第二句给出架构一词：「A zero trust architecture (ZTA) uses zero trust principles to plan industrial and enterprise infrastructure and workflows.」核心假设紧随其后：「Zero trust assumes there is no implicit trust granted to assets or user accounts based solely on their physical or network location (i.e., local area networks versus the internet) or based on asset ownership (enterprise or personally owned).
statement.en: **Standard**: Zero Trust Architecture (SP 800-207) (零信任架构（SP 800-207）).The first abstract sentence places the term: "Zero trust (ZT) is the term for an evolving set of cybersecurity paradigms that move defenses from static, network-based perimeters to focus on users, assets, and resources." The second names the architecture: "A zero trust architecture (ZTA) uses zero trust principles to plan industrial and enterprise infrastructure and workflows." The working assumption follows: "Zero trust assumes there is no implicit trust granted to assets or user accounts based solely on their physical or network location (i.e.

statement.zh: 动机是企业网络趋势使边界失效：「Zero trust is a response to enterprise network trends that include remote users, bring your own device (BYOD), and cloud-based assets that are not located within an enterpriseowned network boundary.」§1 说明边界为何不够：「Perimeter-based network security has also been shown to be insufficient since once attackers breach the perimeter, further lateral movement is unhindered.」并把对手假设写实：「Zero trust security models assume that an attacker is present in the environment and that an enterprise-owned environment is no different--or no more trustworthy--than any nonenterprise-owned environment.
statement.en: The motive is the network trend that dissolves the boundary: "Zero trust is a response to enterprise network trends that include remote users, bring your own device (BYOD), and cloud-based assets that are not located within an enterpriseowned network boundary." Section 1 says why perimeter defences fail: "Perimeter-based network security has also been shown to be insufficient since once attackers breach the perimeter, further lateral movement is unhindered.

statement.zh: 文件先给出七条基本原则（措辞是设计准则的陈述句，不是命令式的义务条款）：「A zero trust architecture is designed and deployed with adherence to the following zero trust basic tenets:」第一条即「All data sources and computing services are considered resources.」§2 又给出一条总体要求：「Overall, enterprises need to develop and maintain dynamic risk-based policies for resource access and set up a system to ensure that these policies are enforced correctly and consistently for individual resource access requests.」并建议不要以登录推断后续请求可信（原文是 should not，不是禁止）：「This means that an enterprise should not rely on implied trustworthiness wherein if the subject has met a base authentication level (e.g.
statement.en: What the document sets out first are seven basic tenets, worded as design principles rather than mandates: "A zero trust architecture is designed and deployed with adherence to the following zero trust basic tenets:", the first being "All data sources and computing services are considered resources." Section 2 adds a general requirement: "Overall, enterprises need to develop and maintain dynamic risk-based policies for resource access and set up a system to ensure that these policies are enforced correctly and consistently for individual resource access requests.

statement.zh: 文件自陈给出的是模型与考虑，不是产品或方案。摘要写：「This document contains an abstract definition of zero trust architecture (ZTA) and gives general deployment models and use cases where zero trust could improve an enterprise's overall information technology security posture.」Audience 段补：「It is not intended to be a single deployment plan for ZTA as an enterprise will have unique business use cases and data assets that require safeguards.
statement.en: The document describes models and considerations, not a product or a plan.The abstract says: "This document contains an abstract definition of zero trust architecture (ZTA) and gives general deployment models and use cases where zero trust could improve an enterprise's overall information technology security posture." The Audience section adds: "It is not intended to be a single deployment plan for ZTA as an enterprise will have unique business use cases and data assets that require safeguards.

statement.zh: 扉页首行为「NIST Special Publication 800-207」，作者与部门行连读为「Scott Rose Oliver Borchert Advanced Network Technologies Division Information Technology Laboratory」，其后另列两位作者的机构：「Stu Mitchell Stu2Labs」与「Sean Connelly Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency」，DOI 行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-207。Authority 段引用行给出日期与页数：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-207, 59 pages (August 2020)」。关键词行是「architecture; cybersecurity; enterprise; network security; zero trust.」署名页（本文拼作 Acknowledgments）交代出处：「This document is the product of a collaboration between multiple federal agencies and is overseen by the Federal CIO Council.
statement.en: The first title-block line reads "NIST Special Publication 800-207", the author and division lines read in sequence as "Scott Rose Oliver Borchert Advanced Network Technologies Division Information Technology Laboratory", with the other two authors and their affiliations given as "Stu Mitchell Stu2Labs" and "Sean Connelly Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency", and the free-access line reads "This publication is available free of charge from:" followed by the DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-207.The citation in the Authority block carries date and length: "Natl.
